children: Three Lions Acquisition completed a $100 million IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 each and placed $100.5 million of IPO and private placement proceeds into a trust. The company also completed a concurrent $4.0 million private placement of 400,000 units with its sponsor, EarlyBirdCapital, and third-party investors. To support the SPAC structure and future merger, Three Lions executed a suite of agreements, including underwriting, warrant, trust, registration rights, escrow, administrative services, marketing, and subscription arrangements. The underwriter holds a 45-day option to purchase up to 1,500,000 additional units.
